## Context / Problem
On the production MCP host, 2026-11-01 21:03-21:35 PST, one compaction sweep (`op=compact-sweep`) held the store write lock 160-250 s per fold across 10 folds (journald evidence on `radiant-benighted-warbler` and `overweak-deviant-shelduck`). A canonical write waits at most about 181 s (30 s x 2 attempts x 3 passes), and a writer that arrives just after a fold starts gets one pass, so plan-review signing and sidecar writes failed with `could not acquire lock after 181s ... op=compact-sweep`. The between-ticket handover fix in `radiant-benighted-warbler` does not shorten a single fold.

Measured on a clone of `tickets` at `daa3a65239b^` replaying the same 10 folds (comment on this ticket):
- The first fold held the lock 58.1 s cold and 11.8-14.4 s warm; 92-98% of it was `identity.resolve_current_identity`, which with no identity pointer reduces every ticket in the store (`_match_by_email`). Ordinary writes resolve that attribution before locking.
- `_build_authorship_ledger` -> `authorship.identify_signer` -> `rebar.show_ticket` -> `ensure_fresh` fetched under the fold's lock, then `sync.reconverge` requested the lock the fold already held and waited out its 2 s pass (bug `congruent-demurrable-insect`).
- The clone does not reproduce production's 160-250 s: folds that replay in under 1 s on the clone held 220-243 s in production. The sweep worker's log (`compact-worker.log`) was empty because the detached worker installs no log handler, so no production per-phase timing exists.

## Approach
Follow the existing compute-before-lock pattern: `finalize_event` stamps attribution before `write_and_push` locks, and `preresolve_unmapped_positions` resolves history walks before the sweep's fold locks.
1. In `_compact_locked`, resolve `_seam.attribution_fields` and a new `preresolve_signers(ticket_dir, repo_root)` map (signed event -> verifying key, keyed by author id and signature) BEFORE `lock.acquire`. Pass the attribution to `compact_plan.build_snapshot_event(..., attribution=...)` (default `None` keeps the fsck rebuild path unchanged) and the map to `_build_authorship_ledger(..., signers=...)`. A key missing from the map (an event written after the prelude) falls back to the existing per-event lookup.
2. Run the locked body under `ticket_reads.local_read_context()`, so no read inside the lock fetches or calls `sync.reconverge`.
3. Add `_FoldTimer`: every fold logs exactly one WARNING line `compaction fold timing: ticket=<id> outcome=<folded|skipped|error>` with seconds for `attribution`, `signers`, `lock_wait`, `recover`, `parse`, `reduce`, `ledger`, `build_snapshot`, `write_retire`, `commit`, `held`. WARNING is the default level of every entrypoint's handler, so it reaches logs with no configuration.
4. In `compact_trigger.run_sweep`, call the idempotent `rebar._logging.install_stderr_handler()` so the detached worker's stderr (`compact-worker.log`) receives the line.
Why this fits: it removes the two measured in-lock costs with an established pattern and no new lock, config key, env var or flag, and gives production the per-phase data the clone cannot.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py`: prelude, `preresolve_signers`, `_FoldTimer`, `_FoldInputs`, `_fold_under_lock`, timed `_apply_fold`.
- `src/rebar/_commands/compact_plan.py`: optional `attribution` parameter on `build_snapshot_event`.
- `src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py`: stderr handler in `run_sweep`.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`: new tests.
Out of scope: whatever consumes production's remaining hold; that is diagnosed from the new timing line after deploy.

## Testing
State, not duration: each probe records whether the store lock dir exists at the call. No autouse fixtures; the cross-process worker test bounds its child with `communicate(timeout=120)` and kills it in `finally`.
- Happy path: `_match_by_email` and `identify_signer` are each called, never under the lock; the SNAPSHOT's `author_id`/`author_email` and the authorship ledger equal those of the in-lock path.
- Remote present and freshness throttle expired: no `_coordinated_fetch`, `sync.reconverge` or second `lock.acquire` while the fold holds the lock.
- Timing: two folds log exactly two lines naming all 11 phases; a fold that skips inside the lock still logs one with `held` and `lock_wait`; a real detached `run_sweep` child writes the line to its stderr.
- Regression: the compaction, lock, concurrency, identity, authorship, snapshot, sync and fsck modules pass; `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Identity attribution and signer lookups run before the store write lock: `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py` observes the lock dir at every `_match_by_email` and `identify_signer` call and finds none under the lock.
- [x] While the fold holds the lock it runs no `git fetch`, no `sync.reconverge` and no second `lock.acquire`: checked by the remote-backed test in `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`.
- [x] The SNAPSHOT's `author_id`/`author_email` and the authorship ledger are unchanged by pre-resolution: checked by the equality tests in `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`.
- [x] Each fold logs exactly one WARNING timing line naming all 11 phases, including a fold that skips inside the lock, and the detached sweep worker writes it to its stderr log: checked by the timing tests in `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`.
- [x] [non-codebase] Replaying the 10 production folds on a clone copy holds the store write lock under the 60 s single-pass budget: the per-fold `held=` values are recorded in a ticket comment.
  provenance: environment=operator workstation, isolated clone of the tickets branch; principal=rebar session a85e3cd3; privilege_posture=local read-write on the clone only, no remote; instrument=compaction fold timing lines from the real sweep loop — the measurement concerns a store copy, not repository files.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The production hold is diagnosed from the new timing lines: after the first production sweep on the deployed change, the `compaction fold timing` lines from `compact-worker.log` and the phase that consumed each fold's hold are recorded in a ticket comment.
  provenance: environment=production MCP host, rebar-mcp container; principal=operator via AWS SSM; privilege_posture=read-only; instrument=SSM AWS-RunShellScript docker exec cat of compact-worker.log — the evidence is production log output, not repository files.
